notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Some bugs have been fixed.

[list]
[*] Lewd Gallery Bug has been fixed: Now, after you unlock the lewd animations, they will be unlocked in the gallery. If you have already started the game, please, start a new one.
[*] Lewd Book 03 has been fixed: Now, you'll see the image instead of a white image.
[*] Black Screen has been fixed: Now, save files from the demo version will be automatically deleted and we hope to fix the black screen problem. Post on the forum (Bug Section) if this bug persists.
[/list]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1743290/Sexcraft__Walkthrough/]Walkthrough Document[/url] is also available. You can buy it 10% OFF during the game launch week.

Thank you all for your patience and don't forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/h-room]Steam page[/url].

New games will be announced soon.

Hentai Room Team
